name: P&S Sheet Metal Miami
old_description: P&S International Supply Corp is a leading sheet metal manufacturing company for all your sheet metal supply needs specializing in HVAC ductwork. We offer laser cutting, welding, and installation services to provide a one-stop solution for all your HVAC needs, whether for new construction or property rehabilitation projects.
about:
P&S International Supply Corp operates from Miami, Florida, where it manufactures custom HVAC ductwork and sheet metal components. The company runs a fabrication facility at 3740 NW 78th Street equipped with multiple in-house laser machines, serving both local and international markets.

The shop produces round, spiral, rectangular, and oval ductwork along with custom elbows, offsets, transitions, roof curbs, and adapters. Primary material is galvanized steel, with stainless steel, aluminum, and black iron also available. Processes include laser cutting, welding, and full sheet metal fabrication. The company also provides takeoffs, duct lists, and quotes from project plans, and can supply sheet metal coils, mechanical equipment, air conditioners, and spare parts. Installation services are offered primarily in Florida, with out-of-state projects considered by scope.

P&S serves mechanical contractors, general contractors, and developers in HVAC, commercial construction, new construction, and property rehabilitation. A noted project is the 250,000-square-foot Elev8 Fun facility in Jensen Beach, where the company delivered the full mechanical scope including equipment.

The company positions itself as a single-source partner—manufacturer, fabricator, and mechanical supplier—emphasizing fast turnaround and same-day availability for certain orders. Nationwide delivery and worldwide export, with frequent shipments to the Caribbean, Virgin Islands, and Latin America, extend its reach beyond South Florida.
